info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Payments Payments Methods-v3-spec
info.description: The Payment Methods Retrieval API allows users to access a comprehensive list of available payment methods for processing transactions. By leveraging this API endpoint, developers can quickly integrate and present payment options to consumers, facilitating smoother checkout experiences. Typical use cases include displaying supported payment options in e-commerce applications and providing customers with updated information on available payment methods. This API is essential for businesses aiming to enhance their payment processing capabilities and improve customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves a list of all available payment methods that can be used for transactions. It provides important details about each method, such as supported currencies and regional availability.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the available payment methods. The client must provide the necessary information to specify the request parameters.

200.description: Returns a list of available payment methods.
